menu_items.name: CHA GIO
menu_items.description: Golden fried spring rolls stuffed with a savory mix of shrimp, crab, and pork. Served with fish sauce for dipping.

menu_items.name: NEM NUONG CUON
menu_items.description: Grilled pork rolls wrapped in soft rice paper with vermicelli, crisp lettuce, fresh mint, and crispy rice paper.

menu_items.name: GOI CUON *GF
menu_items.description: Summer rolls w. shrimp, vermicelli, cucumbers, lettuce and mint served with a creamy dipping sauce.

menu_items.name: MADAME WINGS *GF
menu_items.description: chicken wings glazed in a bold caramelized garlic fish sauce

menu_items.name: BANH XEO
menu_items.description: Vietnamese savory crepe with sautéed shrimp & pork belly. Served with fish sauce. Vegetarian option available upon request.

menu_items.name: BANH KHOT
menu_items.description: Crispy mini coconut-turmeric rice pancakes topped with shrimp, scallion, & crispy shallots

menu_items.name: BANH BOT CHIEN
menu_items.description: Pan fried rice cakes with eggs & scallions topped with fried garlic, diced sausage, cilantro & Fresno chilis. Served with fish sauce.

menu_items.name: GOI BUOI*GF
menu_items.description: A vibrant and spicy pomelo salad tossed with shrimp, green papaya, carrots, daikon, Thai basil, mint, crispy shallots, and roasted peanuts.

menu_items.name: GOI NGO BO
menu_items.description: Spicy Vietnamese beef and cilantro salad topped with crushed peanuts, served with sesame rice paper for scooping and sharing.

menu_items.name: MUC RANG MUOI
menu_items.description: Salt toasted fried squid served with avocado sauce.

menu_items.name: CUA LOT RANG MUOI
menu_items.description: Salt toasted soft-shell crab served with avocado sauce.

menu_items.name: TOM RANG MUOI
menu_items.description: Salt toasted prawns served with avocado sauce.

menu_items.name: MADAME PLATTER
menu_items.description: A feast for the senses: grilled chicken, shrimp, and pork, honey-glazed pork, and crispy fried spring rolls over delicate bánh hỏi noodles. Served with rice paper for wrapping, topped with crushed peanuts, and accompanied by fish sauce.

menu_items.name: THE MADAME PHO *GF
menu_items.description: Aromatic beef broth simmered for 24 hours, served w. rice noodles, sliced eye round, brisket, and beef meatballs. Garnished with fresh cilantro and onions

menu_items.name: PHO CHAY *V
menu_items.description: Savory mushroom-based broth infused with classic pho spices, served w. rice noodles and topped w. shiitake mushrooms,tofu, fresh cilantro, and scallions.

menu_items.name: BUN BO HUE *GF
menu_items.description: Spicy lemongrass broth served with vermicelli noodles, brisket & Vietnamese pork roll.

menu_items.name: TET NOODLES
menu_items.description: Egg noodles wok-tossed in a decadent garlic butter fish sauce, topped with succulent lump crab meat and juicy prawns. Finished with crispy fried garlic

menu_items.name: GARLIC NOODLES
menu_items.description: Rice noodles stir fried with eggs, shrimp, scallions, and garlic.

menu_items.name: HU TIEU CHAY
menu_items.description: Rice noodles stir fried with eggs, tofu, peppers & cilantro.

menu_items.name: VERMICELLI BOWL *V
menu_items.description: Vermicelli noodles, mint, cucumbers, crushed peanuts & fried shallot with choice of: grilled chicken, spicy tofu, honey glazed pork, spicy lemongrass beef, shrimp, cha gio.

menu_items.name: Oxtail Fried Rice
menu_items.description: Fragrant five-spice braised oxtail, rich bone marrow, and sautéed onions, stir-fried with rice and topped with a crispy fried egg, golden shallots, and fresh cilantro

menu_items.name: COM SUON NUONG *GF
menu_items.description: Grilled pork chops served with rice, fried egg,& pickled veggies.

menu_items.name: BO LUC LAC
menu_items.description: Sizzling seared ribeye cubes wok-tossed with scallions and served with a fried egg.

menu_items.name: CA TIM XAO XA OT *V
menu_items.description: Eggplant stir fried with lemongrass, scallions & chili sauce.

menu_items.name: GA XAO XA OT
menu_items.description: Chicken stir fried with lemongrass, peppers, onions, and chili sauce.

menu_items.name: MAMA LY'S FRIED RICE *GF
menu_items.description: Fried rice with shrimp, sausage, eggs, scallions & fried garlic. Vegetarian option available upon request.
